classes.restraint/abandon: The person lets a desire go; retiring it is licensed only by what they said.
classes.restraint/adopt: The person commits to a desire; adopting it is licensed only by what they said.
classes.restraint/firm-assent: The person asks for something to be made firm; over MCP nothing licenses intention_firm (design.md, Open Questions).
classes.restraint/invitation: Answering a seeded invitation is licensed only by the person's answer.
classes.restraint/policy-select: Selection is authorised by the person's firm auto_select policy, not by a choice.
classes.restraint/select: Selecting a placement is licensed only once the person has chosen.
classes.rung/availability: The person says when they are free, held as availability.
classes.rung/desire: A passing remark that should be held as a desire, not an intention.
classes.rung/hedged: A hedged or conditional want that should stay a desire, with no window invented.
classes.rung/intention: A clear intention with a window, held as a tentative intention with the window as said.
classes.rung/none: A remark about the past that should write nothing.
classes.rung/policy: A standing rule the person states, drafted as a tentative terminus carrying a policy.
classes.rung/terminus: A statement of who the person is, drafted as a tentative terminus.

notes: Selection is licensed by key, not by candidate: a run is scored on whether it selected after the person chose, not on which candidate it selected.
Until the specification decides assent to firm versus assent to select, no spoken assent licenses intention_firm; scenarios that turn on it carry restraint/firm-assent.
Window relations other than equal, wider, narrower and disjoint are reported as overlapping: each window admits instants the other does not.
